neighbours.label: the opening of an honorific designation a thing is given ('named the ... of the Year', 'selected as its "Plant of the Year"', 'the poster child', 'the test case')
fire: The state society selected the wax myrtle as its "Plant of the Year" in 2019.
Robertson was named the conference Offensive Rookie of the Year last season.
The abandoned mine has become the poster child for careless exploration.
Biologists see the coyote as the test case for how animals adapt to cities.
The bakery was featured as the magazine's business of the month in April.
Her novel was chosen as the city's book of the year by the library.
The village was crowned the cleanest town in the county again.
The project is the model example of what good planning can achieve.
quiet: The state society planted many wax myrtles along the river in 2019.
Robertson played well for the conference team last season.
The abandoned mine has caused damage to the river for decades.
Biologists study the coyote to learn how animals live in cities.
The bakery was mentioned in the magazine in April.
Her novel was borrowed often from the city library this year.
The village was cleaned up by volunteers in the county again.
The project shows what good planning can achieve.

notes: Top peaks: '“' before Plant of the Year, 'as' featured as, 'Offensive' Rookie of the Year, 'test' case, 'poster' child. Near misses describe the same things without a designation.
